­Johnnyboy123 (81) 🗓31m 👁️658
13 is treated as a "lucky number" or meme number for Robinhood (especially Robinhood
Crypto), mainly because the company was
founded in 2013.

In 2024, the official @RobinhoodCrypto
account posted "Is 13 a lucky number? ••" and
also a post consisting of many repetitions of
"13" ending with the same emoji. Crypto
communities (particularly those discussing a
potential or existing Robinhood-related chain/
L1) have since adopted 13 as a symbolic or
"golden" number-comparable to other chains'
number memes e.g BSC's 4
tying it to the founding year.
